name: Time Flies
source:
This time stage is Kujou workplace. Busy days as usual, but even in ordinary scenery there is time and place to make blood boil.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这一次，故事舞台是九条工作的地方。日子一如既往地忙碌，但即便在平凡的景色中，也总有令人热血沸腾的时刻与场所。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/02/vn-of-month-march-2006-lost-child.html]vndbreview[/url]]
